proof_scope: Reveal-in-editor collaboration surface: the agent (or human) names a file and a line/function/class/JSON field of the problem code or report data, and the debugger opens it in the human's VS Code at that location -- so a stuck agent can point the human straight at the relevant code or receipt field, and the human can then ask for a debug session. Symbol and JSON-field resolution are deterministic; the live reveal is capability-gated on a display + the code CLI.

claims.proves: open_in_vscode.py resolves a function/class to its exact line (Python ast), resolves JSON keys to line/column targets for editor highlighting, rejects unknown symbols, and reveals the file at that line in the running VS Code (title-confirmed) when a display is present
claims.does_not_prove: that the human actually looked, or multi-file cross-reference navigation beyond a single symbol or JSON field

cases.name: resolve-function-to-line
cases.description: Resolve the buggy function running_total to its definition line via the Python ast, without opening anything (deterministic).
command: set -uo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/open_in_vscode.py ../scenarios/variable_state/tally.py --function running_total --print-only

cases.name: resolve-json-field-to-line-column
cases.description: Resolve a JSON report field to the exact line/column VS Code should reveal/highlight, without opening anything.

cases.name: reject-unknown-json-field
cases.description: A missing JSON field must fail closed with JSON_FIELD_NOT_FOUND rather than opening a nearby or arbitrary key.
command:
set -uo pipefail; D="$(mktemp -d)"; printf '{"readiness":"READY"}
' > "$D/report.json"; ../run.sh open "$D/report.json" --json-field missing.path --print-only

cases.name: reject-directory-path
cases.description: A directory with a .json suffix must fail closed instead of being treated as a JSON file.

cases.name: reject-unknown-symbol
cases.description: An unknown symbol must fail closed with SYMBOL_NOT_FOUND rather than opening a wrong or arbitrary location.
command: set -uo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/open_in_vscode.py ../scenarios/variable_state/tally.py --function does_not_exist --print-only

cases.name: live-reveal-in-vscode
cases.description: Open the buggy function in the running VS Code and confirm via the window title that the editor is showing the file. Capability-gated: BLOCKED without a display or the code CLI.
command: set -uo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/open_in_vscode.py ../scenarios/variable_state/tally.py --function running_total
